Contractor All Risk (CAR) · open cover for all Solar ESS sites

CAR insurance: policy summary

Dhipaya Insurance PCL · Policy no. 14021-108-260005210 · Thai title: ประกันภัยความเสี่ยงภัยทุกชนิดของผู้รับเหมาติดตั้ง (English schedule: Erection All Risks). Currently protecting the OPSK site (Starbucks My Park).

Period16 Oct 2026 – 16 Oct 2027+ 12 months maintenance
Contract works (Sec. 1+2)10,000,000 THBest. yearly total; max 5,000,000 per contract
Employer's existing property1,000,000 / 2,000,000per event & project / per year
Third party (Sec. 3)1,000,000 / 2,000,000per event & project / per year

Before and during the OPSK / My Park job

This is an open policy: a site is only covered once it has been declared to the insurer. The copy we hold shows the employer as "(please notify)" and does not name OPSK or My Park.

  • Confirm the endorsement for My Park. Each contract must be notified before its start date and is covered by an endorsement or cover letter. Without it there is no cover. Ask the broker for the My Park endorsement and file it with this policy.
  • Check the contract fits the limits: contract value no more than 5,000,000 THB, construction no more than 5 months, testing no more than 1 week.
  • If the job runs late, tell the insurer in writing before the project end date. They confirm cover and charge extra premium for the extension.
  • Fire safety on site (warranty). Keep extinguishers on site and ready, with trained workers present. Hot work (welding, soldering, open flame) near anything combustible needs a worker with an extinguisher standing by. Store flammables well away from the works. If this isn't followed, fire and explosion claims are not paid.
  • Report the contract value to the broker for the monthly declaration. The year-end premium is adjusted on the real contract total.

Who and where ผู้เอาประกันภัยและสถานที่

  • Insured: the employer (named per project), and/or บริษัท โซลาร์ เอสส์ จำกัด as main contractor, and/or subcontractors, consulting engineers and other contractors on the project.
  • Main contractor address: 53 Moo 2, Tambon Nanglae, Amphoe Mueang Chiang Rai, Chiang Rai 57100.
  • Location: any site in Thailand that is notified to the insurer. Airport/airside areas and offshore sites are excluded.
  • Work insured: rooftop solar PV installation (contract works and installation of machinery and equipment).
  • Other contractors on separate contracts who are not insured under this policy count as third parties.

Cover and limits ความคุ้มครองและวงเงิน

ItemCover / limit
Sec. 1 + 2: contract works and erection (All Risks)Sudden, unforeseen physical loss or damage to permanent and temporary works and materials, unless excluded. Sum insured 10,000,000 THB (estimated yearly total of all contracts), max 5,000,000 THB per contract.
Flood, earthquake, windstorm, hail (combined)Max 10% of contract value per event & project, 1,000,000 THB per year
Employer's existing property (CAR/022)Damage caused by our work that we are legally liable for: 1,000,000 THB per event & project, 2,000,000 THB per year
Sec. 3: third-party liabilityBodily injury and property damage to third parties (not our own workers) arising from the contract work, including legal and defence costs agreed by the insurer in writing: 1,000,000 THB per event & project, 2,000,000 THB per year
Fire-fighting expenses10% of contract value per event & project, 1,000,000 THB per year
Debris removal10% of contract value per event & project, 1,000,000 THB per year
EscalationSum insured rises automatically with contract price increases, up to 20%
Construction equipment, construction machinery, erection tools, architects'/engineers' feesNot covered

Excess (deductible) ความเสียหายส่วนแรก

  • Contract works, Sec. 1 + 2: 10% of the loss, minimum 10,000 THB, whichever is higher, for every claim.
  • Third-party property damage: 10% of the loss, minimum 10,000 THB, whichever is higher.
  • Third-party bodily injury or death: no excess.

Period per project ระยะเวลาคุ้มครองต่อโครงการ

  • Construction period as per each project's contract, max 5 months per project (notify the insurer).
  • Plus testing, max 1 week per project.
  • Plus maintenance, 12 months per project (Extended Maintenance clause). This covers damage we cause while doing maintenance, and damage from defects that arose during installation, before the certificate of completion.
  • Only contracts whose actual work period falls inside the policy year are covered.
  • Automatic extension clause: if the insurer is told in writing before the period ends, the period is extended for late completion at extra premium.

Extensions included เงื่อนไขพิเศษเพิ่มเติม

  • Automatic reinstatement of sum insured (extra premium)
  • Fire-fighting expenses
  • Extended maintenance period, 12 months
  • Debris removal
  • Escalation up to 20%
  • Employer's existing property (CAR/022)
  • Waiver of subrogation (CAR/072)
  • Cross liability: each insured treated as a separate party (CAR/004)
  • Third-party cover during maintenance period
  • Employer's employees and representatives treated as third parties (CAR/047)
  • Employer's employees not working on the project treated as third parties

Main exclusions ข้อยกเว้น

  • Asbestos
  • Seepage, pollution and contamination
  • Radioactive, chemical, biological and electromagnetic weapons
  • Cyber and data loss (LMA 5401); electronic data and internet
  • War and terrorism; sanctions
  • Communicable disease (forms 6 and 7)
  • Professional liability (design errors) is not covered
  • Our own workers are not third parties (they need separate cover)

Open-policy rules เงื่อนไขกรมธรรม์เปิด

  1. Notify each project in advance, before its start date. The insurer issues an endorsement or cover letter. Not notified means not covered.
  2. Notify any time extension in writing before the project end date. Extra premium applies.
  3. The insured or broker reports contract values every month. The premium is adjusted at the end of the policy year.
  4. If the real premium is higher than the minimum, the insurer charges the difference. If it is lower, there is no refund.
  5. If losses exceed 60% over the year, the insurer may reconsider renewal.
  6. Warranty: no loss or incident had happened before the policy was agreed.

If something happens เมื่อเกิดความเสียหาย

  1. Make the site safe and limit the damage.
  2. Notify the insurer at once by phone and in writing (Dhipaya 1736 or 0 2239 2200, and the broker). Written notice must reach the insurer within 14 days.
  3. Keep the damaged parts and take photos. Don't repair, except minor damage, until the insurer's surveyor has had a chance to inspect.
  4. For theft or burglary, file a police report.
  5. Don't admit liability or agree a settlement with a third party without the insurer's written consent.

Premium เบี้ยประกันภัย

Rate0.18% × (contract works + employer's existing property)
Minimum premium0.18% × (10,000,000 + 2,000,000) = 21,600.00 THB
Stamp duty + VAT87.00 + 1,518.09 THB
Total paid23,205.09 THB (minimum and deposit premium, adjusted at year end)
Agreed / issued16 Oct 2026 / 20 Oct 2026
